source.document: Diacronal MR 60 mg modified-release tablets SmPC (PA1347/024/001)

key_sections_summary: MR 30–120 mg once daily; mild–moderate renal impairment: same regimen with monitoring; severe renal or hepatic insufficiency contraindicated (insulin); dialysis of no benefit (95% protein-bound); t1/2 12–20 h; <1% unchanged in urine.
